title: Just OK
text: Just OK. First off, we live on lake Erie in extreme NE Ohio. Our warm temps are nothing like other locations around the country. When temps outside drop to the upper 60's, which is daily, that is the time that this AC can reach it's set temp of 74 without running constantly. Otherwise, this runs all the time at 75 in the day when temps are between 80 and 85. Keep in mind we have new energy efficient double pane windows and cooling a small bedroom space which does not include a walk-in closet or master bath. It is a hard pill to swallow to spend this kind of money and receive something that barely gets the job done.

product_metadata.title: Amana AMAP101AD Portable Air Conditioner with Remote Control in Gold/Black for Rooms up to 250-Sq. Ft.
features: Portable air conditioner with caster wheels for easy movement
5.9-ft. LCDI power cord with 3-prong grounded plug uses 115V electrical outlet
Cools a room up to 250 sq. ft. with up to 5 pints per hour dehumidification
description: Experience portable comfort wherever you are with the Amana portable air conditioner. Designed for cooling and dehumidifying a room up to 250 square feet, this Amana portable air conditioner features on-board electronic controls with 3 speeds and a 24-hour timer, plus a handy remote control with LCD display and an auto-swing option. Our auto-swing louvers with multiple air direction delivers better air distribution making sure there are no "hot spots" in the room. Plus, easy-rolling caster wheels allow you to conveniently move the unit from room to room, providing cool air when and where you need it most. With the included window exhaust kit, it only takes a few minutes to uninstall and reinstall. At Amana we have exactly what you need to keep cool and dry. *See Qualifier Statement

details.Warranty Description: 1-year parts and labor, plus additional 2 years parts on compressor.
details.Included Components: Portable air conditioner, remote control, exhaust hose, window venting kit, manual, warranty
